title: Measure trapezoidal integration error
instructions: Execute the declared numerical computation and retain actual metrics.

command: import json; from pathlib import Path; n=5000; h=1.0/n; observed=h*(sum((i*h)**2 for i in range(1,n))+0.5); metrics={'integral':observed,'absolute_error':abs(observed-1.0/3.0),'intervals':n}; Path('metrics.json').write_text(json.dumps(metrics)); print(json.dumps(metrics),flush=True)
